scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8004 --reload-exclude logs --reload-exclude novel.db --reload-delay 1
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5179 && ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5179 electron ."
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run desktop:backend && electron-forge make
